Reasoning: Low-latitude regions have strong solar radiation and obtain much heat, while high-latitude regions receive less heat. Cross-latitude ocean currents will carry the heat of low-latitude sea areas toward higher latitudes, while promoting the exchange of cold and warm water bodies in sea areas at different latitudes. Therefore, ocean currents play the role of heat transfer and exchange between sea areas at high and low latitudes.

method.method_draft: 读图时先定位北回归线、南回归线和大陆两侧的洋流箭头，确认洋流并非只沿同一纬度运动，而是在高、低纬之间往返流动。再结合低纬受太阳辐射强、高纬受热少的规律，判断这些跨纬度洋流会把低纬热量带到高纬，同时促进不同纬度海区的冷热水体交换。作答为：洋流在高低纬度海区之间起热量传递和交换作用。
